const np = pyimport("numpy")

const hk = pyimport("haiku")
const featurisation = pyimport("alphafold3.data.featurisation")
const pipeline = pyimport("alphafold3.data.pipeline")
const attention = pyimport("alphafold3.jax.attention")
const model_features = pyimport("alphafold3.model.features")
const af3_model = pyimport("alphafold3.model.model")
const params = pyimport("alphafold3.model.params")
const post_processing = pyimport("alphafold3.model.post_processing")

const folding_input = pyimport("alphafold3.common.folding_input")

const _HOME_DIR = homedir()
const _DEFAULT_MODEL_DIR = joinpath(_HOME_DIR, "models")
const _DEFAULT_DB_DIR = joinpath(_HOME_DIR, "public_databases")

function parse_commandline()
    s = ArgParseSettings()
    @add_arg_table! s begin
        "--json_path"
            help = "Path to the input JSON file."
        "--input_dir"
            help = "Path to the directory containing input JSON files."
        "--output_dir"
            help = "Path to a directory where the results will be saved."
            required = true
        "--model_dir"
            help = "Path to the model to use for inference."
            default = string(_DEFAULT_MODEL_DIR)
        "--run_data_pipeline"
            help = "Whether to run the data pipeline on the fold inputs."
            arg_type = Bool
            default = true
        "--run_inference"
            help = "Whether to run inference on the fold inputs."
            arg_type = Bool
            default = true
        "--jackhmmer_binary_path"
            help = "Path to the Jackhmmer binary."
            default = Sys.which("jackhmmer")
        "--nhmmer_binary_path"
            help = "Path to the Nhmmer binary."
            default = Sys.which("nhmmer")
        "--hmmalign_binary_path"
            help = "Path to the Hmmalign binary."
            default = Sys.which("hmmalign")
        "--hmmsearch_binary_path"
            help = "Path to the Hmmsearch binary."
            default = Sys.which("hmmsearch")
        "--hmmbuild_binary_path"
            help = "Path to the Hmmbuild binary."
            default = Sys.which("hmmbuild")
        "--db_dir"
            help = "Path to the directory containing the databases. Can be specified multiple times to search multiple directories in order."
            action = :append_arg
            default = [string(_DEFAULT_DB_DIR)]
        "--small_bfd_database_path"
            help = "Small BFD database path, used for protein MSA search."
            default = "\${DB_DIR}/bfd-first_non_consensus_sequences.fasta"
        "--mgnify_database_path"
            help = "Mgnify database path, used for protein MSA search."
            default = "\${DB_DIR}/mgy_clusters_2022_05.fa"
        "--uniprot_cluster_annot_database_path"
            help = "UniProt database path, used for protein paired MSA search."
            default = "\${DB_DIR}/uniprot_all_2021_04.fa"
        "--uniref90_database_path"
            help = "UniRef90 database path, used for MSA search. The MSA obtained by searching it is used to construct the profile for template search."
            default = "\${DB_DIR}/uniref90_2022_05.fa"
        "--ntrna_database_path"
            help = "NT-RNA database path, used for RNA MSA search."
            default = "\${DB_DIR}/nt_rna_2023_02_23_clust_seq_id_90_cov_80_rep_seq.fasta"
        "--rfam_database_path"
            help = "Rfam database path, used for RNA MSA search."
            default = "\${DB_DIR}/rfam_14_9_clust_seq_id_90_cov_80_rep_seq.fasta"
        "--rna_central_database_path"
            help = "RNAcentral database path, used for RNA MSA search."
            default = "\${DB_DIR}/rnacentral_active_seq_id_90_cov_80_linclust.fasta"
        "--pdb_database_path"
            help = "PDB database directory with mmCIF files path, used for template search."
            default = "\${DB_DIR}/mmcif_files"
        "--seqres_database_path"
            help = "PDB sequence database path, used for template search."
            default = "\${DB_DIR}/pdb_seqres_2022_09_28.fasta"
        "--jackhmmer_n_cpu"
            help = "Number of CPUs to use for Jackhmmer. Defaults to min(cpu_count, 8). Going above 8 CPUs provides very little additional speedup."
            arg_type = Int
            default = min(Sys.CPU_THREADS, 8)
        "--nhmmer_n_cpu"
            help = "Number of CPUs to use for Nhmmer. Defaults to min(cpu_count, 8). Going above 8 CPUs provides very little additional speedup."
            arg_type = Int
            default = min(Sys.CPU_THREADS, 8)
        "--resolve_msa_overlaps"
            help = "Whether to deduplicate unpaired MSA against paired MSA. The default behaviour matches the method described in the AlphaFold 3 paper. Set this to false if providing custom paired MSA using the unpaired MSA field to keep it exactly as is as deduplication against the paired MSA could break the manually crafted pairing between MSA sequences."
            arg_type = Bool
            default = true
        "--max_template_date"
            help = "Maximum template release date to consider. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. All templates released after this date will be ignored. Controls also whether to allow use of model coordinates for a chemical component from the CCD if RDKit conformer generation fails and the component does not have ideal coordinates set. Only for components that have been released before this date the model coordinates can be used as a fallback."
            default = "2021-09-30"
        "--conformer_max_iterations"
            help = "Optional override for maximum number of iterations to run for RDKit conformer search."
            arg_type = Int
        "--jax_compilation_cache_dir"
            help = "Path to a directory for the JAX compilation cache."
        "--gpu_device"
            help = "Optional override for the GPU device to use for inference. Defaults to the 1st GPU on the system. Useful on multi-GPU systems to pin each run to a specific GPU."
            arg_type = Int
            default = 0
        "--buckets"
            help = "Strictly increasing order of token sizes for which to cache compilations. For any input with more tokens than the largest bucket size, a new bucket is created for exactly that number of tokens."
            action = :append_arg
            default = [ "256", "512", "768", "1024", "1280", "1536", "2048", "2560", "3072", "3584", "4096", "4608", "5120"]
        "--flash_attention_implementation"
            help = "Flash attention implementation to use. 'triton' and 'cudnn' uses a Triton and cuDNN flash attention implementation, respectively. The Triton kernel is fastest and has been tested more thoroughly. The Triton and cuDNN kernels require Ampere GPUs or later. 'xla' uses an XLA attention implementation (no flash attention) and is portable across GPU devices."
            default = "triton"
            range_tester = (x) -> x in ["triton", "cudnn", "xla"]
        "--num_recycles"
            help = "Number of recycles to use during inference."
            arg_type = Int
            default = 10
        "--num_diffusion_samples"
            help = "Number of diffusion samples to generate."
            arg_type = Int
            default = 5
        "--num_seeds"
            help = "Number of seeds to use for inference. If set, only a single seed must be provided in the input JSON. AlphaFold 3 will then generate random seeds in sequence, starting from the single seed specified in the input JSON. The full input JSON produced by AlphaFold 3 will include the generated random seeds. If not set, AlphaFold 3 will use the seeds as provided in the input JSON."
            arg_type = Int
        "--save_embeddings"
            help = "Whether to save the final trunk single and pair embeddings in the output. Note that the embeddings are large float16 arrays: num_tokens * 384 + num_tokens * num_tokens * 128."
            arg_type = Bool
            default = false
        "--save_distogram"
            help = "Whether to save the final distogram in the output. Note that the distogram is a large float16 array: num_tokens * num_tokens * 64."
            arg_type = Bool
            default = false
        "--force_output_dir"
            help = "Whether to force the output directory to be used even if it already exists and is non-empty. Useful to set this to True to run the data pipeline and the inference separately, but use the same output directory."
            arg_type = Bool
            default = false
    end
    return parse_args(s)
end

function make_model_config(;flash_attention_implementation="triton", num_diffusion_samples=5, num_recycles=10, return_embeddings=false, return_distogram=false)
    config = af3_model.Model.Config()
    config.global_config.flash_attention_implementation = flash_attention_implementation
    config.heads.diffusion.eval.num_samples = num_diffusion_samples
    config.num_recycles = num_recycles
    config.return_embeddings = return_embeddings
    config.return_distogram = return_distogram
    return config
end

mutable struct ModelRunner
    _model_config
    _device
    _model_dir
    _model_params
    _model_forward
end

function ModelRunner(config, device, model_dir)
    runner = ModelRunner(config, device, model_dir, nothing, nothing)
    @memoize function load_model_params(self)
        return params.get_model_haiku_params(model_dir=self._model_dir)
    end
    runner._model_params = load_model_params(runner)

    @memoize function get_model(self)
        py"""
        import haiku as hk
        from alphafold3.model import model as af3_model
        
        @hk.transform
        def forward_fn(batch, config):
            return af3_model.Model(config)(batch)
        """
        forward_fn = py"forward_fn"
        
        return py"
        import jax
        import functools
        
        def get_jitted_model(forward_fn, params, device):
             return functools.partial(
                jax.jit(forward_fn.apply, device=device), params
             )
        "(forward_fn, runner._model_params, device)
    end
    runner._model_forward = get_model(runner)
    return runner
end

function run_inference(self::ModelRunner, featurised_example, rng_key)
    featurised_example = JAX.device_put(
        JAX.tree_util.tree_map(
            jnp.asarray, model_utils.remove_invalidly_typed_feats(featurised_example)
        ),
        self._device,
    )
    result = self._model_forward(rng_key, featurised_example)
    result = JAX.tree_map(np.asarray, result)
    result = JAX.tree_map(
        x -> x.dtype == jnp.bfloat16 ? x.astype(jnp.float32) : x,
        result,
    )
    result = Dict(result)
    identifier = self._model_params["__meta__"]["__identifier__"].tobytes()
    result["__identifier__"] = identifier
    return result
end

function extract_inference_results(self::ModelRunner, batch, result, target_name)
    return collect(
        af3_model.Model.get_inference_result(
            batch=batch, result=result, target_name=target_name
        )
    )
end

function extract_embeddings(self::ModelRunner, result, num_tokens)
    embeddings = Dict()
    if "single_embeddings" in keys(result)
        embeddings["single_embeddings"] = result["single_embeddings"][1:num_tokens, :].astype(np.float16)
    end
    if "pair_embeddings" in keys(result)
        embeddings["pair_embeddings"] = result["pair_embeddings"][1:num_tokens, 1:num_tokens, :].astype(np.float16)
    end
    return isempty(embeddings) ? nothing : embeddings
end

function extract_distogram(self::ModelRunner, result, num_tokens)
    if !("distogram" in keys(result["distogram"]))
        return nothing
    end
    distogram = result["distogram"]["distogram"][1:num_tokens, 1:num_tokens, :]
    return distogram
end

@with_kw struct ResultsForSeed
    seed::Int
    inference_results
    full_fold_input
    embeddings::Union{Dict{String, Any}, Nothing} = nothing
    distogram::Union{Any, Nothing} = nothing
end


function predict_structure(fold_input_obj, model_runner; buckets=nothing, ref_max_modified_date=nothing, conformer_max_iterations=nothing, resolve_msa_overlaps=true)
    println("Featurising data with $(length(fold_input_obj.rng_seeds)) seed(s)...")
    featurisation_start_time = time()
    
    ccd = chemical_components.cached_ccd(user_ccd=fold_input_obj.user_ccd)
    
    featurised_examples = featurisation.featurise_input(
        fold_input=fold_input_obj,
        buckets=buckets,
        ccd=ccd,
        verbose=true,
        ref_max_modified_date=ref_max_modified_date,
        conformer_max_iterations=conformer_max_iterations,
        resolve_msa_overlaps=resolve_msa_overlaps,
    )
    
    println("Featurising data with $(length(fold_input_obj.rng_seeds)) seed(s) took $(time() - featurisation_start_time:.2f) seconds.")
    println("Running model inference and extracting output structure samples with $(length(fold_input_obj.rng_seeds)) seed(s)...")
    
    all_inference_start_time = time()
    all_inference_results = []
    
    for (seed, example) in zip(fold_input_obj.rng_seeds, featurised_examples)
        println("Running model inference with seed $seed...")
        inference_start_time = time()
        rng_key = JAX.random.PRNGKey(seed)
        result = run_inference(model_runner, example, rng_key)
        println("Running model inference with seed $seed took $(time() - inference_start_time:.2f) seconds.")
        
        println("Extracting inference results with seed $seed...")
        extract_structures_time = time()
        inference_results = extract_inference_results(model_runner, batch=example, result=result, target_name=fold_input_obj.name)
        
        num_tokens = length(inference_results[1].metadata["token_chain_ids"])
        embeddings = extract_embeddings(model_runner, result=result, num_tokens=num_tokens)
        distogram = extract_distogram(model_runner, result=result, num_tokens=num_tokens)
        
        println("Extracting $(length(inference_results)) inference samples with seed $seed took $(time() - extract_structures_time:.2f) seconds.")
        
        push!(all_inference_results, 
            ResultsForSeed(
                seed=seed,
                inference_results=inference_results,
                full_fold_input=fold_input_obj,
                embeddings=embeddings,
                distogram=distogram,
            )
        )
    end
    
    println("Running model inference and extracting output structures with $(length(fold_input_obj.rng_seeds)) seed(s) took $(time() - all_inference_start_time:.2f) seconds.")
    
    return all_inference_results
end

function write_fold_input_json(fold_input_obj, output_dir)
    mkpath(output_dir)
    path = joinpath(output_dir, "$(fold_input_obj.sanitised_name())_data.json")
    println("Writing model input JSON to $path")
    open(path, "w") do f
        write(f, fold_input_obj.to_json())
    end
end

function write_outputs(all_inference_results, output_dir, job_name)
    ranking_scores = []
    max_ranking_score = nothing
    max_ranking_result = nothing
    
    output_terms_path = joinpath(dirname(pathof(af3_cpp)), "OUTPUT_TERMS_OF_USE.md")
    output_terms = read(output_terms_path, String)
    
    mkpath(output_dir)
    
    for results_for_seed in all_inference_results
        seed = results_for_seed.seed
        for (sample_idx, result) in enumerate(results_for_seed.inference_results)
            sample_dir = joinpath(output_dir, "seed-$(seed)_sample-$(sample_idx-1)")
            mkpath(sample_dir)
            
            post_processing.write_output(
                inference_result=result,
                output_dir=sample_dir,
                name="$(job_name)_seed-$(seed)_sample-$(sample_idx-1)",
            )
            
            ranking_score = Float64(result.metadata["ranking_score"])
            push!(ranking_scores, (seed, sample_idx - 1, ranking_score))
            
            if max_ranking_score === nothing || ranking_score > max_ranking_score
                max_ranking_score = ranking_score
                max_ranking_result = result
            end
        end

        if results_for_seed.embeddings !== nothing
            embeddings = results_for_seed.embeddings
            embeddings_dir = joinpath(output_dir, "seed-$(seed)_embeddings")
            mkpath(embeddings_dir)
            post_processing.write_embeddings(
                embeddings=embeddings,
                output_dir=embeddings_dir,
                name="$(job_name)_seed-$(seed)",
            )
        end

        if results_for_seed.distogram !== nothing
            distogram = results_for_seed.distogram
            distogram_dir = joinpath(output_dir, "seed-$(seed)_distogram")
            mkpath(distogram_dir)
            distogram_path = joinpath(distogram_dir, "$(job_name)_seed-$(seed)_distogram.npz")
            npzwrite(distogram_path, Dict("distogram" => distogram.astype(np.float16)))
        end
    end

    if max_ranking_result !== nothing
        post_processing.write_output(
            inference_result=max_ranking_result,
            output_dir=output_dir,
            terms_of_use=output_terms,
            name=job_name,
        )
    end
    
    open(joinpath(output_dir, "$(job_name)_ranking_scores.csv"), "w") do f
        writer = CSV.Writer(f)
        CSV.write(writer, [["seed", "sample", "ranking_score"]])
        CSV.write(writer, ranking_scores)
    end
end

function replace_db_dir(path_with_db_dir, db_dirs)
    if occursin("\${DB_DIR}", path_with_db_dir)
        for db_dir in db_dirs
            path = replace(path_with_db_dir, "\${DB_DIR}" => db_dir)
            if ispath(path)
                return path
            end
        end
        throw(FileNotFoundError("$(path_with_db_dir) with \${DB_DIR} not found in any of $(db_dirs)."))
    end
    
    if !ispath(path_with_db_dir)
        throw(FileNotFoundError("$(path_with_db_dir) does not exist."))
    end
    return path_with_db_dir
end

function process_fold_input(fold_input_obj; data_pipeline_config, model_runner, output_dir, buckets=nothing, ref_max_modified_date=nothing, conformer_max_iterations=nothing, resolve_msa_overlaps=true, force_output_dir=false)
    println("\nRunning fold job $(fold_input_obj.name)...")
    if isempty(fold_input_obj.chains)
        throw(ValueError("Fold input has no chains."))
    end
    
    if !force_output_dir && ispath(output_dir) && !isempty(readdir(output_dir))
        new_output_dir = "$(output_dir)_$(Dates.format(now(), "YYYYmmdd_HHMMSS"))"
        println("Output will be written in $new_output_dir since $output_dir is non-empty.")
        output_dir = new_output_dir
    else
        println("Output will be written in $output_dir")
    end
    
    if data_pipeline_config === nothing
        println("Skipping data pipeline...")
    else
        println("Running data pipeline...")
        fold_input_obj = pipeline.DataPipeline(data_pipeline_config).process(fold_input_obj)
        write_fold_input_json(fold_input_obj, output_dir)
    end
    
    if model_runner === nothing
        println("Skipping model inference...")
        output = fold_input_obj
    else
        println("Predicting 3D structure for $(fold_input_obj.name) with $(length(fold_input_obj.rng_seeds)) seed(s)...")
        all_inference_results = predict_structure(
            fold_input_obj,
            model_runner,
            buckets=buckets,
            ref_max_modified_date=ref_max_modified_date,
            conformer_max_iterations=conformer_max_iterations,
            resolve_msa_overlaps=resolve_msa_overlaps,
        )
        println("Writing outputs with $(length(fold_input_obj.rng_seeds)) seed(s)...")
        write_outputs(
            all_inference_results=all_inference_results,
            output_dir=output_dir,
            job_name=fold_input_obj.sanitised_name(),
        )
        output = all_inference_results
    end
    
    println("Fold job $(fold_input_obj.name) done, output written to $output_dir\n")
    return output
end

function main()
    parsed_args = parse_commandline()

    if parsed_args["jax_compilation_cache_dir"] !== nothing
        py"jax.config.update('jax_compilation_cache_dir', ${parsed_args["jax_compilation_cache_dir"]})"
    end

    if (parsed_args["json_path"] === nothing) == (parsed_args["input_dir"] === nothing)
        throw(ArgumentError("Exactly one of --json_path or --input_dir must be specified."))
    end

    if !parsed_args["run_inference"] && !parsed_args["run_data_pipeline"]
        throw(ArgumentError("At least one of --run_inference or --run_data_pipeline must be set to true."))
    end

    if parsed_args["input_dir"] !== nothing
        fold_inputs = folding_input.load_fold_inputs_from_dir(parsed_args["input_dir"])
    elseif parsed_args["json_path"] !== nothing
        fold_inputs = folding_input.load_fold_inputs_from_path(parsed_args["json_path"])
    else
        @assert false "Exactly one of --json_path or --input_dir must be specified."
    end
    
    try
        mkpath(parsed_args["output_dir"])
    catch e
        println("Failed to create output directory $(parsed_args["output_dir"]): $e")
        rethrow()
    end
    
    if parsed_args["run_inference"]
        gpu_devices = py"jax.local_devices(backend='gpu')"
        if !isempty(gpu_devices)
            compute_capability = Float64(gpu_devices[parsed_args["gpu_device"]].compute_capability)
            
            if compute_capability < 6.0
                throw(ErrorException("AlphaFold 3 requires at least GPU compute capability 6.0 (see "))
            elseif 7.0 <= compute_capability < 8.0
                xla_flags = get(ENV, "XLA_FLAGS", "")
                required_flag = "--xla_disable_hlo_passes=custom-kernel-fusion-rewriter"
                if !occursin(required_flag, xla_flags)
                    throw(ErrorException("For devices with GPU compute capability 7.x (see  the ENV XLA_FLAGS must include \"$required_flag\"."))
                end
                
                if parsed_args["flash_attention_implementation"] != "xla"
                    throw(ArgumentError("For devices with GPU compute capability 7.x (see  the --flash_attention_implementation must be set to \"xla\"."))
                end
            end
        end
    end

    notice = """
    Running AlphaFold 3. Please note that standard AlphaFold 3 model
    parameters are only available under terms of use provided at
    
    If you do not agree to these terms and are using AlphaFold 3 derived
    model parameters, cancel execution of AlphaFold 3 inference with
    CTRL-C, and do not use the model parameters.
    """
    println("\n" * notice * "\n")
    
    max_template_date = Date(parsed_args["max_template_date"], "yyyy-mm-dd")
    
    data_pipeline_config = nothing
    if parsed_args["run_data_pipeline"]
        expand_path(x) = replace_db_dir(x, parsed_args["db_dir"])
        data_pipeline_config = pipeline.DataPipelineConfig(
            jackhmmer_binary_path=parsed_args["jackhmmer_binary_path"],
            nhmmer_binary_path=parsed_args["nhmmer_binary_path"],
            hmmalign_binary_path=parsed_args["hmmalign_binary_path"],
            hmmsearch_binary_path=parsed_args["hmmsearch_binary_path"],
            hmmbuild_binary_path=parsed_args["hmmbuild_binary_path"],
            small_bfd_database_path=expand_path(parsed_args["small_bfd_database_path"]),
            mgnify_database_path=expand_path(parsed_args["mgnify_database_path"]),
            uniprot_cluster_annot_database_path=expand_path(parsed_args["uniprot_cluster_annot_database_path"]),
            uniref90_database_path=expand_path(parsed_args["uniref90_database_path"]),
            ntrna_database_path=expand_path(parsed_args["ntrna_database_path"]),
            rfam_database_path=expand_path(parsed_args["rfam_database_path"]),
            rna_central_database_path=expand_path(parsed_args["rna_central_database_path"]),
            pdb_database_path=expand_path(parsed_args["pdb_database_path"]),
            seqres_database_path=expand_path(parsed_args["seqres_database_path"]),
            jackhmmer_n_cpu=parsed_args["jackhmmer_n_cpu"],
            nhmmer_n_cpu=parsed_args["nhmmer_n_cpu"],
            max_template_date=max_template_date,
        )
    end
    
    model_runner = nothing
    if parsed_args["run_inference"]
        devices = py"jax.local_devices(backend='gpu')"
        println("Found local devices: $devices, using device $(parsed_args["gpu_device"]): $(devices[parsed_args["gpu_device"]])")
        
        println("Building model from scratch...")
        model_runner = ModelRunner(
            make_model_config(
                flash_attention_implementation=parsed_args["flash_attention_implementation"],
                num_diffusion_samples=parsed_args["num_diffusion_samples"],
                num_recycles=parsed_args["num_recycles"],
                return_embeddings=parsed_args["save_embeddings"],
                return_distogram=parsed_args["save_distogram"],
            ),
            device=devices[parsed_args["gpu_device"]],
            model_dir=parsed_args["model_dir"],
        )
        
        println("Checking that model parameters can be loaded...")
        _ = model_runner._model_params
    end
    
    num_fold_inputs = 0
    for fold_input_obj in fold_inputs
        if parsed_args["num_seeds"] !== nothing
            println("Expanding fold job $(fold_input_obj.name) to $(parsed_args["num_seeds"]) seeds")
            fold_input_obj = fold_input_obj.with_multiple_seeds(parsed_args["num_seeds"])
        end
        
        process_fold_input(
            fold_input_obj,
            data_pipeline_config=data_pipeline_config,
            model_runner=model_runner,
            output_dir=joinpath(parsed_args["output_dir"], fold_input_obj.sanitised_name()),
            buckets=Tuple(parse(Int, bucket) for bucket in parsed_args["buckets"]),
            ref_max_modified_date=max_template_date,
            conformer_max_iterations=parsed_args["conformer_max_iterations"],
            resolve_msa_overlaps=parsed_args["resolve_msa_overlaps"],
            force_output_dir=parsed_args["force_output_dir"],
        )
        
        num_fold_inputs += 1
    end
    
    println("Done running $num_fold_inputs fold jobs.")
end

if abspath(PROGRAM_FILE) == @__FILE__
    main()
end
